pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpetunti te thokaṃ yeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tatheva suddhakāḷakānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū thokaṃ yeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tatheva suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.6: “saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave thokaṃyeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tatheva suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpethā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.9: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā thokaṃyeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tatheva suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.11: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:-
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.12.1: “navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārayamānena dve bhāgā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ ādātabbā, tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ, catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.13: anādā ce bhikkhu dve bhāge suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ, catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ, navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.13: anādā ce bhikkhu dve bhāge suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ catutthaṃ gocariyānanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.14: anādiyitvā dve tulā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ, tūlaṃ odātānaṃ, tulaṃ gocariyānaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.16: nissajitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.19: “idamme bhante navaṃ santhataṃ anādiyitvā [dve tulā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ,] tulaṃ odātānaṃ, tulaṃ gocariyānaṃ kārāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.24.1: attanā vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.25: attanā vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.26: parehi vippakataṃ attanā pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.27: parehi vippakataṃ parehi pariyosāpeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.28: aññassatthāya karoti vā kārāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.31: tulaṃ odātānaṃ tulaṃ gocariyānaṃ ādiyitvā karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.32: bahutaraṃ odātānaṃ bahutaraṃ gocariyānaṃ ādiyitvā karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.33: suddhaṃ odātānaṃ suddhaṃ gocariyānaṃ ādiyitvā karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.34: vitānaṃ vā bhummattharaṇaṃ vā sāṇipākāraṃ vā bhisiṃ vā bibbohanaṃ vā karoti.
